fields.title: Make idempotent
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: Rephrase so that retries are harmless, without an idempotency key.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — «record accrual for order X: 50 points», tying it to the order provides idempotency. 2 — not needed, a lost or duplicate view is harmless, and this is a conscious choice. 3 — «send notification of type `delivered` for order X», recipient stores the fact of sending. 4 — «record stock reservation for order item X», not «decrease by 1». General technique: tie the operation to a natural event identifier instead of describing a change.
